name: D-Frame Sunglasses
fit_note: Clean Copenhagen panto in warm tortoise. COS doesn't publish sizes.

name: Turner (L)
colour: Milk Havana (milky cream front, havana arms) / solid brown polarised
fit_note: The cream front matches his ecru, stone and white-linen pieces and the havana arms with brown polarised lenses go with his brown suede Premiatas and chocolate knits; it is the only polarised colour without a black front (Sepia has purple non-polarised lenses), and opaque cream does not repeat his clear lilac pair.

name: Marlon Grand (L)
colour: Wood (dark brown woodgrain havana) / green gradient polarised
fit_note: Swapped from Black Sand to Wood because the dark brown havana with green-gradient polarised lenses looks the most old-money (the other colours are near-black, clear Ash or Caramel Russet with a purple-tinted lens) and works with navy, khaki, sage and brown suede; it comes in one 146 mm size made for larger faces.

name: River
fit_note: Olive acetate with flat grey lenses picks up his sage and khaki and looks good with navy and cream; Amber/green is archived, and the remaining colours are black, blue-gradient or a translucent brown-gradient that would repeat his lilac pair; it comes in one size, 139.9 mm, just under his 142 mm.

name: Belle
fit_note: Of the only two colours (the other is black with green lenses), the warm cola brown with grey-gradient lenses suits his chocolate, cream and stone outfits and brown suede shoes, and the single 144 mm size is close to his 142 mm.

name: Ned Extra Large
colour: Satin gold + tigerwood acetate rim / green
fit_note: Satin Gold Tigerwood is Ned's only sunglass colour (there is no silver version), but the gold is brushed and mostly covered by tortoise rims so it sits fine next to his steel Datejust, and the green lenses suit navy, light blue and sage; XL measures 142.5 mm hinge to hinge (146 mm overall front), which matches his 142 mm hinge-to-hinge reference, while Medium is only 139 mm front and 136 mm hinge to hinge.

name: Croupier Polarized
colour: Havana Brown (warm striped havana) / solid brown polarised
fit_note: Warm havana with brown polarised lenses goes with his navy, cream and chocolate pieces and brown suede Premiatas; it is polarised for only €5 more than Carey Terracota, whose brown-gradient lens would repeat his lilac pair (the third colour is a blue fashion lens), and at 141 mm it is almost exactly his 142 mm.

name: Hudson Large
fit_note: Caramel havana with green lenses is the classic Ralph Lauren pairing for navy, cream, light blue and khaki, and it beats Jurassic (olive with brown lenses) and Sugar Man (dark tortoise with grey) for his warm palette; Large (145.1 mm) is closer to 142 mm than Medium (138.7 mm), and Ace & Tate shows low online stock.
